text.p: Cytec Industries Inc said on Thursday it would consolidate its North American industrial surfactants and docusate manufacturing into its Willow Island, West Virginia facility.

As part of the consolidation, Cytec said it would close its Linden, N.J. plant, which employed about 85 people. About 25 of those people were not directly involved with manufacturing and would be transferred to another site in New Jersey, the company said.

The industrial chemical company said its West Virginia facility would provide additional capacity and new equipment for surfactants and docusates manufacturing. The company said these facilities were larger and more modern.

Industrial surfactants are used in products like emulsion polymers, paints and adhesives, the company said. Docusates are used in the manufacture of pharmaceuticals, food additives and over the counter products, the company said.
